name: Sesamoid Stress Fracture of the Great Toe
tags: sesamoid stress fracture of the great toe
definition: Stress injury or fracture of a hallux sesamoid caused by repetitive forefoot loading, common in dancers and runners.

investigations.principle: Radiographs and MRI help distinguish acute fracture, stress injury and bipartite sesamoid.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, tendon, cartilage, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent nonunion or displaced fracture may need surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi stress-injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Stress injury or fracture of a hallux sesamoid caused by repetitive forefoot loading, common in dancers and runners.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
